step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor extracted from the MR preamplifier circuit. In a testbench, it can be configured as a basic common-source amplifier stage by adding a load resistor, representing a fundamental gain block of the overall preamplifier.

paper_reference.title: A 455-Mb/s MR Preamplifier Design in a 0.8-m CMOS Process

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain of the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Vgs=0.9V, Vth=0.42V, Vov=0.48V. Id = 0.5 * 270u * (5/0.5) * 0.48^2 = 311 uA. gm = 2*Id/Vov = 1.3 mA/V. Assuming an added load resistor RL=2k to keep it in saturation (Vds = 1.8 - 0.62 = 1.18V), ro = 1/(0.1*311u) = 32k. Rout = 2k || 32k = 1.88k. Gain = gm * Rout = 1.3m * 1.88k = 2.44 V/V = 7.7 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 43 dB for the entire multi-stage preamplifier. A single common-source stage with a resistive load in 130nm will typically yield 5-10 dB of gain.

bandwidth_3dB.description: The frequency at which the voltage gain drops by 3 dB from its low-frequency value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming an added load capacitance CL=100fF. f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * CL) = 1 / (2 * pi * 1.88k * 100fF) = 846 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is highly dependent on the load capacitance. With a nominal 100fF load, the bandwidth exceeds the paper's 273 MHz (which was for the full complex circuit in an older 0.8um process).

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the bias voltage of 0.9V and the transistor dimensions (W=5u, L=0.5u).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC operating point, AC voltage gain, and -3dB bandwidth of the single NMOS transistor configured as a common-source amplifier with an artificial 2kOhm resistive load and 100fF capacitive load.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Common-Source Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Biasing and Loads
VDD VDD 0 1.8
RL VDD N2 2k
CL N2 0 100f

* Input Signal (DC bias + AC perturbation)
VIN N0 0 dc 0.9 ac 1

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let id = -i(VDD)
let dc_power = id * 1.8
print id dc_power

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1Meg 10Gig
let gain_db = vdb(N2)

* Measure low frequency gain
meas ac max_gain_db max gain_db

* Calculate 3dB drop point and measure bandwidth
let gain_3db = max_gain_db - 3
meas ac f_3db when gain_db="$&gain_3db" fall=1

print max_gain_db f_3db

quit
.endc
.end
